**Data set (ordered)**  

\[
2,\;4,\;4,\;4,\;5,\;5,\;7,\;9
\]

Number of observations  

\[
N = 8
\]

---

## 1. Mean  

\[
\bar{x}= \frac{\displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{N} x_i}{N}
\]

\[
\begin{aligned}
\sum x_i &= 2+4+4+4+5+5+7+9 = 40\\[2mm]
\bar{x} &= \frac{40}{8}=5
\end{aligned}
\]

**Mean = 5**

---

## 2. Median  

For an even‑sized sample the median is the average of the two central values.

\[
\text{Median}= \frac{x_{(N/2)}+x_{(N/2+1)}}{2}
\]

The 4th and 5th ordered values are \(4\) and \(5\):

\[
\text{Median}= \frac{4+5}{2}=4.5
\]

**Median = 4.5**

---

## 3. Mode  

The mode is the value(s) that occur most frequently.

| Value | Frequency |
|-------|-----------|
| 2 | 1 |
| 4 | **3** |
| 5 | 2 |
| 7 | 1 |
| 9 | 1 |

**Mode = 4**

---

## 4. Range  

\[
\text{Range}= \max(x)-\min(x)
\]

\[
\text{Range}= 9-2 = 7
\]

**Range = 7**

---

## 5. Population Variance  

\[
\sigma^{2}= \frac{\displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{N}(x_i-\bar{x})^{2}}{N}
\]

| \(x_i\) | \(x_i-\bar{x}\) | \((x_i-\bar{x})^{2}\) |
|---------|----------------|-----------------------|
| 2 | \(-3\) | 9 |
| 4 | \(-1\) | 1 |
| 4 | \(-1\) | 1 |
| 4 | \(-1\) | 1 |
| 5 | 0 | 0 |
| 5 | 0 | 0 |
| 7 | 2 | 4 |
| 9 | 4 | 16 |
| **Sum** | – | **32** |

\[
\sigma^{2}= \frac{32}{8}=4
\]

**Population variance = 4**

---

## 6. Population Standard Deviation  

\[
\sigma = \sqrt{\sigma^{2}} = \sqrt{4}=2
\]

**Population standard deviation = 2**

---

> [!NOTE]  
> Summary of results  

| Statistic | Value | Formula |
|-----------|------:|---------|
| Mean | 5 | \(\displaystyle\frac{\sum x_i}{N}\) |
| Median | 4.5 | \(\displaystyle\frac{x_{(4)}+x_{(5)}}{2}\) (average of middle two) |
| Mode | 4 | most frequent value |
| Range | 7 | \(\max(x)-\min(x)\) |
| Population variance (\(\sigma^{2}\)) | 4 (units²) | \(\displaystyle\frac{\sum (x_i-\bar{x})^{2}}{N}\) |
| Population standard deviation (\(\sigma\)) | 2 | \(\sqrt{\sigma^{2}}\) (square‑root of variance) |
